description: The public registration record for any address in Whisper's space, in RFC 9083 form: the handle, the agent's label, its country, and the entities behind it. The same document the RDAP service serves at /ip/{address}, which any RDAP client can already read. Answers without an API key. Example call: {"skill":"rdap","input":"2a04:2a01:b69a:6717:e3b0:51ff:3bf7:f478"}

input.description: The indicator to look up: a domain, an IP address, an ASN or a file hash. The example passes 2a04:2a01:b69a:6717:e3b0:51ff:3bf7:f478.

name: whisper_rdap

outputSchema.description: The public registration record for one address, RFC 9083 shaped, byte-for-byte what the RDAP service serves at /ip/{address}.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the registration.

entities.description: The parties behind the registration, in RFC 9083 entity form.

events.description: Registration lifecycle events with their timestamps.

handle.description: The registry handle for this address.

name.description: The label its owner gave it.

notices.description: Service-level notices, including the terms of use.

rdapConformance.description: The RDAP extensions this answer conforms to.

remarks.description: Free-text notes the registry publishes with the object.

status.description: Registry status values for the object.

type.description: What kind of allocation this is.

title: Look up an address in RDAP
